title: UnitCoder: Scalable Code Synthesis from Pre-training Corpora
authors_zh: Yichuan Ma、Yunfan Shao、Peiji Li、Demin Song、Qipeng Guo、Linyang Li、Xipeng Qiu、Kai Chen
paper_type_zh: 代码合成单元测试训练数据论文
best_for_zh: 研究从代码语料构建可执行训练数据或代码合成的研究者。
one_line: UnitCoder mines functions and unit tests from pre-training corpora, using test execution to filter scalable code-synthesis training data.
UnitCoder 从预训练语料中挖掘函数与单元测试，借助测试执行筛出可用于代码合成训练的大规模样本。
why: UnitCoder mines functions and unit tests from pre-training corpora, using test execution to filter scalable code-synthesis training data.
inclusion_reason: UnitCoder 从预训练语料中挖掘函数与单元测试，借助测试执行筛出可用于代码合成训练的大规模样本。

title: Problem
问题
html:
Pretraining code corpora are large and API-diverse but have inconsistent quality and no executable supervision. Synthetic methods starting from a small set of high-quality instructions are more reliable but constrained by seed distributions and introduce teacher preferences into problem statements. Simply discarding raw functions that fail tests would also lose long-tail APIs and complex implementations.

UnitCoder automatically generates unit tests for functions from pretraining corpora, iteratively repairs failing code, and refines style after tests pass, converting raw code into large-scale verifiable post-training data while attempting to preserve original functionality.

预训练代码语料规模大、API 多样，但质量不稳定且缺少可执行监督；从少量高质量指令出发的合成方法较可靠，却受种子分布限制，并会把 teacher 的题面偏好写入数据。直接丢弃不能通过测试的原始函数又会损失长尾 API 与复杂实现。

UnitCoder 为预训练函数自动生成单元测试，对失败代码迭代修复并在通过后优化风格，在尽量保持原功能的同时把原始代码转成大规模可验证后训练数据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: UnitCoder releases more than 500K executable Python code samples covering over 370 unique API calls. Instead of first rewriting code into new instructions, it extracts functions from pretraining corpora with AST parsing and uses generated tests as direct quality supervision. Failed samples are repaired by a bug-fix agent using execution traces, and passing samples are refined for readability. Records include original functions, generated tests, execution results, and repaired or refined code for code SFT and complex API-composition training.

UnitCoder 发布超过 500K 条可执行 Python 代码样本，覆盖 370 多种独特 API 调用。它不先把代码改写成新指令，而是用 AST 从预训练语料抽取函数，生成测试作为直接质量监督；失败样本经 bug-fix agent 利用错误轨迹修正，通过后再由 refine agent 改善可读性。数据记录包括原函数、生成测试、执行结果、修复/优化代码，可用于 code SFT 和复杂 API 组合训练。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Function extraction: AST parsing retains syntactically complete Python code that can be independently wrapped, together with API information.
  2. Test generation: A unit-test generator fine-tuned on human-written Python tests creates normal, boundary, and complex package-call cases.
  3. Execution classification: Functions and tests run in a sandbox; passing records proceed to refinement, while failures retain stack traces.
  4. Iterative repair: A bug-fix agent modifies code from failure traces and reruns tests until success or a round limit.
  5. Style refinement: A refine agent improves readability and reruns tests, releasing only functionality-preserving outputs. Experimental agents use Llama3-70B and Qwen2.5-72B; the full compute budget is not disclosed.

1. 抽取函数：AST 解析预训练语料，保留语法完整、可独立封装的 Python 代码及 API 信息。
  2. 生成测试：用人工 Python 测试微调 unit-test generator，为正常、边界和复杂包调用生成用例。
  3. 执行分类：在沙箱运行函数与测试；通过项进入优化，失败项保留错误堆栈。
  4. 迭代修复：bug-fix agent 依据失败轨迹修改代码，重复执行直至通过或达到轮数上限。
  5. 风格优化：refine agent 改善可读性并重新测试，只有功能保持者发布。实验代理使用 Llama3-70B、Qwen2.5-72B；完整计算预算未披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html: With the same base models, adding UnitCoder data raises Llama3.1-8B from 31.0% to 40.4% on BigCodeBench and from 5.4% to 14.2% on BigCodeBench-Hard. InternLM2.5-7B improves from 27.9% to 39.3%, and from 10.1% to 17.6% on the Hard split. In a controlled ablation, general code data scores 29.4%, adding verified data raises it to 35.2%, and the full verified-and-refined data reaches 39.3%. This supports contributions from both test verification and refinement, although training mixtures and source-corpus differences still affect attribution.

在相同基座上，加入 UnitCoder 数据后 Llama3.1-8B 的 BigCodeBench 从 31.0% 升至 40.4%，BigCodeBench-Hard 从 5.4% 升至 14.2%；InternLM2.5-7B 从 27.9% 升至 39.3%，Hard 从 10.1% 升至 17.6%。受控消融中，一般代码数据为 29.4%，加入仅验证数据升至 35.2%，完整 verified-and-refined 数据达 39.3%。结果支持测试验证和 refinement 均有贡献，但训练混合比例与源语料差异仍影响归因。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Methods such as OSS-Instruct first ask a strong model to synthesize new problems from source code and then generate answers and tests, making diversity dependent on the instruction teacher. UnitCoder changes the supervision entry point by treating pretraining functions directly as objects to verify and repair, with unit tests deciding acceptance while preserving original APIs and behavior. Automated tests and repair agents are not individually new. The novelty is treating failing code as material for iterative processing rather than discarding it, followed by post-refinement execution to preserve long-tail package-call distributions.

OSS-Instruct 等方法先让强模型根据原代码合成新题，再生成答案和测试，数据多样性受 instruction teacher 影响。UnitCoder 改变的是监督入口：直接把预训练函数当作待验证和修复的对象，用 unit tests 决定是否接受，并尽量保留其原 API 与功能。自动测试和修复 agent 本身不新，新意在于将“失败代码”视为可迭代加工的原料，而不是删除，并用 refine 后再次执行保证质量，从而保留长尾包调用分布。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Test false positives: Generated tests may cover only surface behavior, allowing incorrect code to pass. Reuse should report coverage and mutation score and verify with an independent test generator.
  2. Functional drift: Bug-fix and refinement agents may change a function into an implementation that satisfies tests but has different semantics. Re-running the same tests is insufficient; documentation, call relations, and differential inputs should be compared.
  3. Source and licensing: The data inherits duplication, contamination, and licensing risks from pretraining corpora and focuses on Python/API scenarios. Provenance must be audited and evaluation repositories isolated before training.

1. 测试假阳性：生成测试可能只覆盖表面行为，错误代码也能通过；复用时应报告覆盖率、mutation score，并用独立测试生成器复核。
  2. 功能漂移：bug-fix 和 refine agent 可能把原函数改成满足测试但语义不同的实现；仅重跑同一测试不足，应比较文档、调用关系和差分输入。
  3. 来源与许可：数据继承预训练语料的重复、污染和许可证风险，且以 Python/API 场景为主；训练前必须审计 provenance，并按仓库隔离评测集。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Code SFT construction: Extract functions from a private codebase, generate tests, repair failures, and output executable training records.
  2. Pretraining-corpus screening: Without creating new problem statements, label raw code by test outcome and repair count for weighted sampling.
  3. Repair-agent training: Retain failure traces, before-and-after code, and final test states as execution-feedback trajectories. When functions depend on external networks, uncontrolled state, or lack trustworthy behavioral specifications, automated tests do not provide a stable verifier and human or environment-level validation is needed.

1. 构建代码 SFT：从自有代码库抽取函数，生成测试、修复失败项并输出可执行训练记录。
  2. 筛选预训练语料：不必生成新题面，可按测试结果和修复次数为原代码打质量标签，再做加权采样。
  3. 训练修复 agent：保留失败堆栈、修改前后代码与最终测试状态，形成 execution-feedback 轨迹。若函数依赖外部网络、不可控状态或没有可信行为规范，自动测试无法提供稳定 verifier，应转为人工或环境级验证。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning: It uses automated testing, repair, and refinement to convert raw pretraining code into verified post-training data.
  2. Method handle: AST extraction, a unit-test generator, failure-trace repair, and post-refinement retesting are central.
  3. Data handle: The release contains more than 500K executable samples covering over 370 APIs.
  4. Evidence anchor: InternLM2.5-7B improves from 27.9% to 39.3% on BigCodeBench.
  5. Reuse decision: It fits codebase data processing. Incomplete tests and functional drift are the main risks, requiring independent test audits.

1. 一句话定位：它用自动测试、修复和优化把原始预训练代码变成 verified post-training data。
  2. 方法抓手：AST 抽取、unit-test generator、失败轨迹修复和 refine 后复测最关键。
  3. 数据抓手：开放超过 500K 条可执行样本，覆盖 370 多种 API。
  4. 证据锚点：InternLM2.5-7B 在 BigCodeBench 从 27.9% 升至 39.3%。
  5. 复用决定：适合代码库数据加工；最大风险是测试不足和功能漂移，必须用独立测试审计。
